item.title: Urgent Request for Action – Ongoing Littering, 24th August
item.description:
I am writing to raise ongoing concerns about anti-social behaviour and persistent littering in the alleyway opposite Clock House Railway Station, between the station and Kings Hall Road. Despite previous reports, the area continues to be used for drinking, with beer cans, bottles, and other rubbish regularly being left behind. I note that Veolia recently inspected the area. However, it appears that the space beneath the staircase was not fully inspected or cleaned, as a significant amount of litter remains and has been there for several weeks. This area is becoming increasingly unsightly and is a growing concern for local residents. I believe this matter now requires urgent attention. Please could the Council arrange for a thorough inspection and clean-up of the area beneath the stairs as soon as possible. It may also be worth considering boarding off or securing this space, as it appears to be regularly used for dumping rubbish. The alleyway and staircase are currently in a very poor condition, and there has been little visible improvement despite repeated reports. Given the ongoing nature of this problem, I believe it is now appropriate for senior Council management and our local MP to review both the issue and the response to it. I would appreciate an urgent update on the action that will be taken.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Kings Hall Road, Penge, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
